flow_transcript_slices.question: Tell me about yourself and why early childhood education matters to you.
flow_transcript_slices.candidate_transcript:
[Q1 Attempt 1]
So I started as a preschool teacher when I was 18. I was in the infant and toddler rooms. I worked my way to supervisor and then I supervised 13 teachers and like 36 infants and toddlers. I ended up really liking it. I really didn't know that child development, child education was something I wanted to do. It just kind of, when I was 18, fell into my lap and then I just went with it. Then I became a mom. So now I have a two-year-old and having my background in child development has helped with that a lot because I've been able to bring my child like throughout all the centers I've worked at. So like that really helps me. And then the last jobs I've had, I've worked at kinder care which I really really liked and I also worked at the YMCA. I just moved from San Diego but I grew up here in Orange County area the first 10 years of my life but I've been out in San Diego for like the past 14 years. So I moved back to be with family and yeah I'm continuing my education right now. I am on track to graduate in December with my site supervisor permit. Thank you. I got a better opportunity. They weren't paying very much so it was better paying then I ended up moving to Temecula so that was that was not very good drive and I was also pregnant so yeah just a lot happened when I was pregnant and it was a lot of moving around and a lot of trying to settle.
